summary: node1 now runs the Node.js application as the rootless nodeapp account in the node-hello container and service. http://10.100.29.10:8080/ returns exactly Hello, world!
actions_performed: Created locked, non-login nodeapp with subordinate UID/GID mappings.
Configured node-hello.service through rootless user Quadlet with systemd lingering.
Opened TCP 8080 in the runtime and permanent public firewall configuration.
Verified automatic startup without an interactive login by stopping and system-starting nodeapp’s user manager.

evidence.requirement: Run the Node.js application in rootless Podman as nodeapp
evidence.summary: nodeapp is a locked non-login service account with subuid/subgid mappings. Podman reports rootless=true, node-hello is running, its command is node /app/server.js, and Node.js reports v22.23.2.

evidence.requirement: Use node-hello as both container and service name
evidence.summary: Quadlet generated node-hello.service with ContainerName=node-hello; final state reports the service active/running and container node-hello running.

evidence.requirement: Return exactly Hello, world! from / on TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: The service listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, runtime and permanent firewall access are enabled, and the managed-IP request returned HTTP 200 with an exact 13-byte match.

evidence.requirement: Start without requiring an interactive login
evidence.summary: Healthy HTTP was captured first. nodeapp is locked with nologin, lingering is enabled, and node-hello is linked into the user default target. Stopping the user manager removed the listener; system-starting it restored node-hello automatically, with the exact response verified again.
